purpose: Small, mechanism-focused generalization diagnosis of independent candidate/reference source selection; not a population accuracy estimate.

recommended_baseline.runtime: Current product files at the reference commit, with the already-decided thinking-enabled configuration.
recommended_baseline.skill_group_label: G2-equivalent current product files; do not silently replay G1.
recommended_baseline.sampling: Keep the existing supported production/evaluation settings fixed and record the actual wire payload; do not introduce arbitrary new temperature values.

cold_start: Fresh backend/workspace/session; prepared business data but zero old user/assistant/tool messages or resultRefs; initial message contains only text.
preserve_current_defaults: Keep normal product system/workspace instructions and the controlled Skill directory. Do not inject an evaluator-written source-resolution rule into model context.
holdout_isolation: Administrative reservation, not encryption or access control. If the change author reads reserve details, label that set regression rather than unseen validation.
